shortDescription: Hamdan Al Shamsi Lawyers & Legal Consultants is a UAE law firm providing litigation, arbitration, and legal advisory services.
whatTheyDo: The firm advises corporate and private clients on banking and finance, corporate and commercial law, construction, real estate, and dispute resolution. It represents parties before UAE local courts, the DIFC Courts, the ADGM Courts, and regional arbitration tribunals. Practice teams manage both onshore civil litigation and common-law cross-border disputes.
address: Office 401, Bay Square Building 1, Marasi Drive, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: The Legal 500 - HAS Law Firm Profile

notes: The firm brands digitally as HAS Law Firm; the input lists Downtown, but its registered office is in Bay Square, Business Bay.

shortDescription: Hasbro is a global toy, game, and entertainment company operating commercial and distribution activities in the UAE through regional subsidiaries.
whatTheyDo: Hasbro oversees the distribution, brand licensing, and retail accounts for its portfolio of toys, board games, and entertainment properties across the Middle East and North Africa. In Dubai, it coordinates commercial sales, merchandising, and partner relations with regional retailers and e-commerce platforms. Key local operational functions focus on regional key account management and demand forecasting.
address: Reef Tower, Cluster O, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Gulf News - Al Hokair Group partners with Hasbro

notes: The input listed Business Bay, but Hasbro's registered entities in Dubai are Hasbro Emerging Markets B.V. in JLT and Hasbro MENA FZE in JAFZA; there is no corporate office in Business Bay.

shortDescription: Hays is a global specialist recruitment firm providing professional recruitment and workforce solutions across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Hays FZ LLC supplies recruitment consultancy, executive search, and contractor staffing services across various sectors in the Middle East. It recruits specialists in technology, finance, construction, human resources, and marketing for regional corporate clients. The firm also publishes the annual GCC Salary Guide providing hiring market insights.
address: Office 2003, Al Thuraya Tower 1, Al Falak Street, Dubai Media City, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Gulf News - Hays GCC Salary Guide Coverage

notes: The input listed JLT, but Hays Dubai office is located in Al Thuraya Tower 1, Dubai Media City.

shortDescription: Help AG is a cybersecurity consultancy and managed security services provider operating as the cybersecurity arm of e& enterprise.
whatTheyDo: Help AG provides managed detection and response, cloud security, cyber defense architecture, offensive security, and threat intelligence services across the Middle East. It operates 24/7 Security Operations Centers (SOCs) monitoring and mitigating cyber threats for regional government entities and enterprises. Technical teams conduct penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and security incident response.
address: Building 3, 12th Floor, The Galleries, Downtown Jebel Ali, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Gulf News - Help AG Launches New Security Services

notes: The input listed Dubai Internet City, but Help AG's primary Dubai headquarters is located in The Galleries Building 3 in Downtown Jebel Ali.

shortDescription: Henkel is a German multinational consumer goods and chemical company operating its GCC regional headquarters in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Henkel manages regional operations for its Consumer Brands and Adhesive Technologies business units across the Middle East. It supplies adhesive solutions to construction and industrial manufacturing sectors, alongside consumer retail brands in laundry, home care, and hair care. Regional operations based in Dubai oversee brand management, marketing, financial controlling, and supply chain logistics.

shortDescription: Hilton is an international hospitality company operating hotels and a regional corporate headquarters for the Middle East & Africa in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Hilton operates, manages, and franchises a wide portfolio of hotels and resorts across multiple brands in the EMEA region. Its regional corporate office in Dubai provides central leadership across hotel development, brand management, sales and revenue management, marketing, and human resources. UAE-based teams oversee hotel operations and early talent programs.

sources.title: Hotelier Middle East - Hilton Regional Office Coverage

shortDescription: HORECA Trade was a foodservice distributor in the UAE that officially rebranded as Bidfood UAE under the global Bidcorp Group.
whatTheyDo: Bidfood UAE (formerly HORECA Trade) imports and distributes food, beverage, and culinary supply solutions to hotels, restaurants, catering businesses, and cafes throughout the UAE. It operates temperature-controlled storage and logistics distribution fleets from Dubai Investment Park. Commercial teams manage category sourcing, brand representation for international food producers, and B2B ordering platforms.
address: Plot No. 597-974, Dubai Investment Park 2, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Caterer Middle East - HORECA Trade Rebranding to Bidfood

shortDescription: Howden is an international insurance intermediary providing risk consulting, insurance, and reinsurance brokerage services in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Howden operates licensed insurance brokerage and reinsurance intermediary services through offices in the DIFC and onshore Dubai. It advises corporate clients on employee benefits, property and casualty insurance, financial lines, and specialized risks across the Middle East. The firm structures risk management solutions and handles policy administration and claims advisory.

notes: The input listed Dubai Internet City, but Howden's Dubai offices are located in DIFC (Gate Village 5) and Sheikh Zayed Road (Latifa Towers); it maintains no office in Dubai Internet City.

shortDescription: HSBC Bank Middle East is the regional banking subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc, headquartered in Downtown Dubai.
whatTheyDo: HSBC Bank Middle East offers personal and wealth banking, commercial banking, and global banking and markets services throughout the Middle East and North Africa. In the UAE, it manages corporate finance, global trade and receivables, capital financing, private wealth management, and retail banking services. Its Downtown Dubai headquarters houses executive leadership, risk management, financial engineering, and technology teams.
address: HSBC Tower, Emaar Square, Downtown Dubai, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: IMG Worlds of Adventure is an indoor themed amusement destination in Dubai, owned by the Ilyas & Mustafa Galadari Group.

It provides live entertainment, family attractions, retail merchandise stores, and themed dining venues. Park operational teams manage guest relations, ticketing, retail sales, ride safety operations, and ride mechanical maintenance.
